title: lig50K tube recon pilot - MNase check
body:
### 1. MNase testing of TW, YY samples

Estimated theoretical conc. = 11.2 ng/uL

*dMNase → 1:1000 dilution*

| Reagent | Volume |
| :---- | :---- |
| DNA | 1.4 uL* |
| MNase Buffer | 5 uL |
| rAlbumin | 0.25 uL |
| dMNase | 1 uL |
| TOTAL | 50 uL |

*As a control load 0.2 uL of the lig50K DNA (no nuc).

Treat at 37 C, 10 mins.

Run on a 0.8% agarose gel and stain with SYBR Green.

Loading Order:

- 100 bp DNA ladder
- 1 kb Extend ladder
- lig50k [No MNase]
- lig50k-nuc [No MNase]
- lig50k [MNase]
- lig50k [MNase]
- lig50k-nuc [MNase]
- lig50k-nuc [MNase]
